title: Shipment dispatch handler booking carrier pickups
name: Carrier pickup dispatcher

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this handler deals with redelivered messages and failed carrier calls? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
How long does the handler wait before the third delivery of a message whose first two attempts released it?
What protects against the carrier booking two pickups if the same shipment's request is sent to the carrier twice?
choices: The `idempotency-key: pickup-<shipmentId>` header, assuming the carrier honors it

questions.prompt: What happens on the delivery where receiveCount reaches MAX_ATTEMPTS and the carrier call still fails?
choices: The error is rethrown without ack or release, leaving the message's fate to the queue's own visibility and redrive policy
The message is acked and dropped
The message is released with a 300-second delay
The handler retries in-process until success
